toss-apex-height.basis: ball apex fit (249 detections) vs the floor from pose; scale from your height; a toss nearer the camera than your body reads high (corrected with a 0.25 m prior)
toss-apex-height.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

toss-drop.basis: free fall from the toss apex to contact (½·g·t²); scale-free

contact-height-ratio.basis: ball on its toss path at the contact time (fused); scale from your height
contact-height-ratio.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

toss-forward.basis: ball apex in front of your front toe at release; scale from your height
toss-forward.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

contact-forward.basis: ball at contact in front of your front toe at release; scale from your height
contact-forward.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

leg-drive.basis: mid-hip height from its lowest point after release to contact, as % of your height
leg-drive.unlockHint: Building your range: 1 of 2 sessions from this set-up.

drive-time.basis: time from your lowest hip point to contact

loading-depth.basis: mid-hip dip from toss release to its lowest point, as % of your height (a description, never a target)

deep-bend-flag.basis: front-leg thigh and shin heights at the lowest hip point vs their standing lengths (experimental; never "little bend")
deep-bend-flag.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

shoulder-tilt-trophy.basis: shoulder line at the lowest hip point, compared only with your own range (never shown in degrees)
shoulder-tilt-trophy.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

trophy-pause.basis: hips and both hands still around the lowest hip point (experimental thresholds)

landing-distance.basis: where your front foot landed, from your front toe at release (trend only)
landing-distance.unlockHint: Record in the app with motion access on, so we can level the picture.

speed-experimental.basis: ball track just after contact (side view)
speed-experimental.unavailableReason: Needs the target you aimed at.
speed-experimental.unlockHint: Tag where you aimed: T, body or wide.

serve-count.basis: serves found by the engine (confirm the strip to make this "measured")

retoss-count.basis: tosses caught (no hit after the toss)
